payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for predicting different types of discourse relations, indicating which types the model works best and worst for.

claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting explicit discourse relations, with a macro F1-score of over 92%.
The model performs worst for implicit discourse relations, achieving a macro F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing contingency relations, with a performance increase of 1.42%.
The model demonstrates better performance on comparison and temporal relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 and 7 points respectively.
